tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Mayer-Vietoris sequence of Klein bottle] ↗ thm:excision-general 1. ch2:2.47\group Singular Homology

Writing the Klein bottle as two Möbius bands gives $\Phi :\mathbb {Z}\to \mathbb {Z}^2$, $1\mapsto (2,-2)$. Thus $H_2(K)=0$ and $H_1(K)\cong \mathbb {Z}\oplus \mathbb {Z}_2$. \end{example}
